description: The Italian Conference of Physics Students (CISF) is the most important event organized by the Italian Association of Physics Students (AISF). The event revolves around the AGM (Annual General Meeting), featuring lectures, seminars, social events, round tables, exhibitions, and laboratory visits. 170 students from across Italy will gather in Bologna for five days of social and scientific events. Public and private partnerships will allow us to keep fees accessible, because we believe CISF belongs to everyone.
shortDescription: Organized by the AISF Bologna local committee, the event offers a unique opportunity for dialogue, personal growth, and professional development.
